title: Divi Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of Divi’s visual builder, site-wide template controls, and design-system workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Divi WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
price: Check current plans on the official site
highlights: Elegant Themes documents full-site, drag-and-drop editing for headers, footers, and individual pages
The visual builder includes on-canvas editing, responsive controls, global styles, and class-based presets
The Theme Builder can apply visual templates across posts, products, categories, and other site areas
bestFor: Teams that want an all-in-one visual-building system and are prepared to standardize on Divi’s editor and design conventions.
researchScope: This profile checks current Elegant Themes product and support documentation. It describes the documented visual-builder workflow, not an independent performance or lock-in assessment.
caveats: No controlled install, content-migration exercise, Core Web Vitals benchmark, or third-party compatibility test has been completed. Assess the long-term editor and migration fit before standardizing on Divi.
